literal: Like friends, good things even if they say, foes' words quickly will be perceived.
translation: Even if foes speak pleasant words as though they were friends, the true nature of their words will quickly be understood.
modern: நண்பர்களைப் போல நல்ல வார்த்தைகளைச் சொன்னாலும், பகைவர்களின் சொற்களின் உண்மைத் தன்மை விரைவாகப் புரிந்து கொள்ளப்படும்.
explanation: This couplet warns about the deceptive speech of enemies who pretend to be well-wishers. The word 'நட்டார்' refers to true friends who have formed a genuine bond, while 'ஒட்டார்' refers to foes who do not truly unite or agree with you. Even if these enemies speak pleasant and agreeable words ('நல்லவை'), their underlying hostility cannot be hidden for long. The phrase 'ஒல்லை உணரப்படும்' emphasizes that the deceitful nature of their words will swiftly be perceived by a discerning mind.
